gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noticia-text: Dignified, in a classic serif way, Noticia Text sits under a rough, loud Unkempt. Its big curved entrances and tall lowercase give the pair a literary steadiness that the heading's marker-nib roughness keeps from going stiff.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-piazzolla: Unkempt's crossbar and stem match in weight, giving it a blunt, hand-cut look. Piazzolla follows in a text serif whose lowercase stands nearly as tall as its capitals, so the rough headline and the tidy paragraph feel like two voices in one conversation.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-pridi: Pridi takes the body, a serif with small letters standing proud and nearly capital-sized. Under Unkempt's wiry, hand-drawn headline, a long page would read with generous space around each curve, refined and unhurried.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-scope-one: A smooth drawn-wire line, as if cut from strips of equal width, defines Unkempt's headlines. Scope One then fills the text with a big x-height and counters that spill into the surrounding space, and a long page of it would read with a traditional, open ease.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-slabo-13px: Rough, round, wiry lettering up top. Slabo 13px settles underneath as a bookish serif with large open counters, and its dignity gives Unkempt's rim-matches-stem letters something sturdy to lean against.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-suwannaphum: Unkempt writes like a marker nib that ignores direction. Its heading is all raw expression, while Suwannaphum, a text serif with a high, squared-off x-height and a wide-open c, brings the editorial dignity.
gen-gf-vampiro-one-fs-paquito: Vampiro One sets a high midline and stretched spacing, with line weight that shifts quietly like brushed watercolor. Paquito, a classic serif with almost no gap between x-height and caps, grounds it confidently and is comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-vibes-fs-karma: Bold lettering with lowercase packed up near the caps and no stroke contrast at all defines Vibes. And Karma, a text serif with middling contrast and terminals clear of the stem, supplies the trustworthy, classic reading that Vibes leaves alone.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-fs-asap: Asap reads as open arcs in a body height that nearly matches its capitals. And the friendly, single-width handwriting of Waiting for the Sunrise makes that combination inviting, though it is better for brief copy.
gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-fs-epilog: Epilogue reads as approachable and contemporary, a wire-like monoline sans with curvy, unclamped letters and stubby ascender tips. And Waiting for the Sunrise, handwritten and friendly, loosens it further, though the pair is not meant for long paragraphs.
